import subprocess, json
PROG = ["python3", "/app/submission/main.py"]
cases = {
  "empty": b"",
  "whitespace only": b"   \n\t ",
  "deep nest": b"[" * 5000 + b"]" * 5000,
  "deep nest obj": b'{"a":' * 3000 + b"1" + b"}" * 3000,
  "huge int": b'{"version":' + b"9" * 5000 + b"}",
  "string root": b'"hello"',
  "number root": b"42",
  "true root": b"true",
  "null root": b"null",
  "trailing data": b'{"version":1} extra',
  "two docs": b'{"version":1}{"version":1}',
  "single quotes": b"{'version':1}",
  "nan nested": b'{"version":1,"config":{"x":NaN}}',
  "bom": b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"version":1}',
  "utf8 id": '{"version":1,"config":{"x":"é"}}'.encode(),
  "control char in string": b'{"version":1,"a":"\x01"}',
  "lone surrogate": b'{"version":1,"a":"\\ud800"}',
  "int float mix": b'{"version":1.0}',
}
for name, raw in cases.items():
    p = subprocess.run(PROG, input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    out = p.stdout[:80]
    print("%-22s rc=%d out=%r stderr=%d" % (name, p.returncode, out, len(p.stderr)))
PYEOF
